palette_rationale: Preserve the reviewed gold body, dark belly, red and purple armor, white claws, green source eyes and black outline from the approved Idle palette.
reference: Own DSTS chr190 mesh and native clips; PMDO registry supplies action names and event fields.
ground_policy_note: Grounded with fixed row-47 shadow. Preserve bounded native lift and recoil; never trim Idle or Physical Attack.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Own armored quadrupedal travel cycle; endpoint excluded.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Own grounded rising bite and recovery. The alternate ba01 root jump exits the approved camera framing and remains unused for Physical Attack.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Own open-mouth release gesture; no invented projectile, glow, or effect.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Own low resting loop; no painted eyelids.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Own ordinary backward recoil. Rolling and inverted bd02/bd03 reactions remain unused.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Bounded first 0.45 seconds of the own low claw sweep with reverse-sampled recovery; later inversion and camera exit are excluded.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two visual cycles of the own rising bite; one PMDO HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Source-bounded launch anticipation with reverse recovery. The native jump leaves the approved camera after 0.16 seconds, so its off-frame inversion is excluded without scaling the sprite down.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Bounded own forward crouch and brace with reverse recovery; later airborne root motion is excluded and no aura is invented.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Own ready motion with whole-view yaw for engine Rotate; endpoint excluded.
